title: Import a .zip file
lead: Upload a Polygon package as a .zip and follow the import.

form.codeInvalid: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only (1 to 32 characters).
form.mainLanguageHint: The language name on Polygon, for example vietnamese.
form.languageMapHint: One pair per line as polygon-name=en, =vi or =skip.
form.appendSolution: Append the main solution to the problem
form.pointsRange: Points from {min} to {max}, or leave empty.
form.ignoreBatchesHint: Zero-point test groups (usually the examples) are not judged; examples stay in the statement.
form.ignoreCasesHint: Single zero-point tests are not judged.
form.appendSolutionHint: Publish the main solution code with the editorial; solvers will see it.

progress.title: Importing {code}
progress.runningHint: the page asks again every 2 seconds
progress.doneText: Import finished. Open the problem to check it and keep editing.
progress.failed: The import failed. The system gives no further reason.

failedSteps.generating: generating the tests on a judge
failedSteps.finishing: placing the data files after saving

progress.pollFailed: Could not fetch the status yet. The page will try again.

stopped.notFound: This import was not found. Imports expire after 24 hours.
stopped.forbidden: You may not view this import.
stopped.unknown: The queue no longer knows this import.
stopped.gaveUp: The status could not be fetched after several tries. Reload the page to try again.
